📨 Sending + reply alerts (optional)

A small free script in your Google account sends applications from your Gmail with your resume attached, then pings your phone when a company replies. Only you can use it. This part is easiest on a computer, and takes about 10 minutes, once.

1 Resume in Google Drive

Upload your resume PDF to Google Drive, open it, and copy the ID from the link: drive.google.com/file/d/this-part/view

2 Get the phone app

Install the free ntfy app from the App Store (on Android, get it on Google Play). Tap + and subscribe to a topic name only you would guess. Here's a random one:

Allow notifications when it asks. Alerts also come to your email.

3 Add the script

Open script.google.com for a new project, delete what's there, and paste this in. At the top, fill in your resume ID and your ntfy topic.

Peek at the code

      
4 Turn it on

        
    
          
  1. Deploy → New deployment → pick Web app. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Only myself. Deploy and approve.
    2. 
          
  2. Pick setup in the function menu and press Run. Your phone should buzz with a test alert.

⚡ Autofill button

      
A bookmark that fills in your name, email, phone and address on application forms, and highlights where to attach your resume.

      
      

      
On iPhone (Safari)
        
    
          
  1. Tap Copy Autofill code above.
    2. 
          
  2. In Safari, open any page, tap the Share button → Add Bookmark, name it Autofill, and save.
    3. 
          
  3. Open your bookmarks, tap Edit, tap the Autofill bookmark, clear the address, and paste the code. Tap Done.
    4. 
          
  4. On a job application, open bookmarks and tap Autofill.

      
On a computer
